FX-RSR-001.says: As added: Warp at 50 per cent, scanned top to bottom, on the card filmed scanning in 80 per cent of a frame. Frame 0 is the layer's first, its motion before taken as the motion after turned round; frame 5 its last.

FX-RSR-002.says: Rate 80, the camera's own: the slant taken out.

FX-RSR-003.says: Rate 0: the layer exactly as it is.

FX-RSR-005.says: Bottom to Top on the card scanned top to bottom: the slant doubled, not taken out.

FX-RSR-006.says: Left to Right on the card panning down and scanned left to right.

FX-RSR-007.says: Right to Left on the same card.

FX-RSR-010.says: Pixel Motion Detail keyed from 20 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4: 60 at frame 2.

FX-RSR-012.says: Rate keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4: 50 at frame 2, as added.

FX-RSR-013.says: Pixel Motion Blur's disc running over nothing, Pixel Motion at 100: only its own pixels move.

FX-RSR-014.says: An Exposure of +1 before Rolling Shutter Repair: the frames it reads are brightened too.

FX-RSR-015.says: An Exposure of -1 after Rolling Shutter Repair darkens its picture.

FX-RSR-016.says: The holder moved 3 right and 2 down: FX-RSR-001 moved.

FX-RSR-017.says: The layer's in point at frame 2: frame 2 is its first, its motion before taken as the motion after turned round.

FX-RSR-018.says: The effect on an adjustment layer above the holder: nothing changes, and the frame says why.

FX-RSR-019.says: The card on twos: each frame's held side takes the other side's motion turned round.

FX-RSR-020.says: Rolling Shutter Rate 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RSR-021.says: Rolling Shutter Rate -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RSR-022.says: Scan Direction written "diagonal". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RSR-023.says: Method written "optical". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RSR-024.says: Pixel Motion Detail 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RSR-025.says: Rolling Shutter Rate keyed to 150 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RSR-026.says: Detailed Analysis written "yes". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
